```{r}
#Packages:
library(brms) #version 2.23.0, Bayesian GLMM fitting
library(dplyr) #version 1.1.4, for data manipulation
library(tidyr) #version 1.3.1, for data reshaping
library(tibble) #version 3.3.0, for data frame handling
library(bayesplot) #version 1.14.0, MCMC and PP check plots
library(tidybayes) #version 3.0.7, Posterior draws extraction
library(ggplot2) #version 3.5.2, visualizations
library(loo) #version 2.8.0, model comparisons
```

```{r}
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr") #cmdstanr version 0.8.0, Stan backend for brms package
```

```{r}
#Data loading:
df_blood <- read.csv("../data/Lauer_etal_DNAm_blood_finalSB.csv")
```

```{r}
# Z-scoring as standardization for body mass and final SB:
bodymass_mean <- mean(df_blood$BodyMass, na.rm = TRUE)
bodymass_sd   <- sd(df_blood$BodyMass,   na.rm = TRUE)

finalsb_mean  <- mean(df_blood$FinalSB,  na.rm = TRUE)
finalsb_sd    <- sd(df_blood$FinalSB,    na.rm = TRUE)


# Apply factors / numeric conversions
df_blood <- df_blood %>%
  mutate(
    timeday = as.numeric(timeday),
    CGsite = as.factor(CGsite),
    BirdID = as.factor(BirdID),
    BodyMass = as.numeric(BodyMass),
    DNAm = as.integer(DNAm),
    BodyMassz = (BodyMass - bodymass_mean) / bodymass_sd,
    FinalSBc  = (FinalSB  - finalsb_mean)  / finalsb_sd   # qPCR Ct value at euthanasia
  )


df_blood <- df_blood %>%
  mutate(
    EP     = factor(EP,
                    levels = c("high","low")),
    Stage  = factor(Stage,
                    levels = c("Female","Juvenile","Male")),
    CGsite = factor(CGsite, levels = c("CG-01","CG-02","CG-03","CG-04","CG-05")),
    BodyMassz = as.numeric(BodyMassz),
    FinalSBc = as.numeric(FinalSBc)
  )

#Z-score time during infection
timeday_mean <- mean(df_blood$timeday, na.rm = TRUE)
timeday_sd   <- sd(df_blood$timeday,   na.rm = TRUE)

df_blood <- df_blood %>%
  mutate(timedayz = (timeday - timeday_mean) / timeday_sd)
```

#MODEL COMPARISON for Model 1 - Leave One-Out Cross Validation with `loo`
```{r}
#Candidate model definition, fitting for comparison, and LOO-IC extraction:
#All use Bernoulli distribution with a logit link function because DNAm is a binary variable

#DNAm binary behavior at each CpG site at each time point
#timedayz: z-score centered time of infection (0 is the pre-infection time point)
#CGsite: categorical identifier of CpG site - CpG 1 is the same here as in Kilvitis et al. 2019
#EP: categorical high or low determined in Sheldon et al. 2023
#Stage: juvenile, male, or female - Sheldon et al., 2023
#BodyMassz: z-score centered body mass in grams taken at capture in Sheldon et al. 2023

#Interaction structure:
#timedayz*CGsite: interaction of time and CpG site to capture the behaviors of each of the sites at each of the timepoints for DNAm - for downstream slope extraction at each CpG site
#(1+timedayz|BirdID): each bird has its own intercept and time slope to account for variability in response to time of infection; estimates the slope per bird of DNA methylation change over time for each CpG site
#(1|BirdID:CGsite): random effect for repeated measures over CpG sites nested within Bird ID

#Model i:
form_dnam_complex <- bf(
  DNAm ~ timedayz * CGsite + EP + Stage + BodyMassz +
         (1 + timedayz | BirdID:CGsite),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model ii: 
form_dnam_sep <- bf(
  DNAm ~ timedayz*CGsite + EP + Stage + BodyMassz +
         (1 + timedayz | BirdID) + (1 | BirdID:CGsite),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model iii:
form_dnam_reduced <- bf(
  DNAm ~ timedayz + CGsite + EP + Stage + BodyMassz +
         (1 + timedayz | BirdID) + (1 | BirdID:CGsite),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model iv:
form_dnam_cgslopes <- bf(
  DNAm ~ timedayz * CGsite +
         (1 + timedayz | BirdID) + (1 | BirdID:CGsite),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)
```

```{r}
#Priors for all DNA methylation models:
priors_dnam_sep <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b"),            
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 1)", class = "sd"),   
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 2.5)", class = "Intercept"), 
  set_prior("lkj(2)", class = "cor")  

)
```

```{r}
#Subsetting the data for all complete cases for all models in comparison
#Data subset is only used in LOO model comparison. The selected model is fit over the full dataset.
df_blood_cc <- df_blood %>%
  filter(complete.cases(DNAm, timedayz, CGsite, EP, Stage, BodyMassz))
```

```{r}
#Model fitting for candidate models:
#Model i:
fit_complex_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_complex,
  data    = df_blood_cc,
  prior   = priors_dnam_sep,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 6000,
  warmup  = 3000,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed    = 1234,
  refresh = 200
)

#Model ii:
fit_sep_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_sep,
  data    = df_blood_cc,
  prior   = priors_dnam_sep,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 6000,
  warmup  = 3000,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed    = 1234,
  refresh = 200
)

#Model iii:
fit_reduced_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_reduced,
  data    = df_blood_cc,
  prior   = priors_dnam_sep,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 6000,
  warmup  = 3000,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed    = 1234,
  refresh = 200
)

#Model iv:
fit_cgslopes_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_cgslopes,
  data    = df_blood_cc,
  prior   = priors_dnam_sep,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 6000,
  warmup  = 3000,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed    = 1234,
  refresh = 200
)
```

```{r}
#LOO comparison:
fit_complex_loo    <- add_criterion(fit_complex_loo,     "loo")
fit_sep_loo    <- add_criterion(fit_sep_loo,     "loo")
fit_reduced_loo <- add_criterion(fit_reduced_loo, "loo")
fit_cgslopes_loo <- add_criterion(fit_cgslopes_loo, "loo")
loo_compare(fit_complex_loo, fit_sep_loo, fit_reduced_loo, fit_cgslopes_loo)
```

```{r}
print(fit_cgslopes_loo$criteria$loo)
print(fit_reduced_loo$criteria$loo)
print(fit_sep_loo$criteria$loo)
print(fit_complex_loo$criteria$loo)
```

```{r}
#Prints the metrics used in model comparison:
#Candidate models
#eldp_loo and standard error - 
#p_loo - effective number of parameters, shows the complexity/parsimony trade-offs
#looic and standard error - 
#elpd_diff and standard error - 

#Report N = 943 in table heading.

loo_list <- list(
  fit_cgslopes_loo = fit_cgslopes_loo$criteria$loo,
  fit_sep          = fit_sep$criteria$loo,
  fit_minimal_loo  = fit_minimal_loo$criteria$loo,
  fit_reduced      = fit_reduced$criteria$loo,
  fit_complex      = fit_complex$criteria$loo
)

loo_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(loo_list, function(x) {
  e <- x$estimates
  tibble::tibble(
    elpd_loo    = e["elpd_loo","Estimate"], se_elpd_loo = e["elpd_loo","SE"],
    p_loo       = e["p_loo","Estimate"],    se_p_loo    = e["p_loo","SE"],
    looic       = e["looic","Estimate"],    se_looic    = e["looic","SE"]
  )
}, .id = "Model")

comp <- loo_compare(fit_cgslopes_loo, fit_sep, fit_minimal_loo, fit_reduced, fit_complex)
comp_df <- as.data.frame(comp) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Model") %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, elpd_diff, se_diff)

loo_table <- dplyr::left_join(loo_summary, comp_df, by = "Model")

loo_table <- loo_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Model = dplyr::recode(Model,
    fit_cgslopes_loo = "cgslopes (selected)",
    fit_sep           = "sep (full covariates)",
    fit_minimal_loo   = "minimal",
    fit_reduced       = "reduced",
    fit_complex       = "complex (BirdID:CGsite slope)"
  ))

loo_table
```


#Model fitting for Model 1

```{r}
fit_cgslopes <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_cgslopes,
  data    = df_blood,
  prior   = priors_dnam_sep,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 6000,
  warmup  = 3000,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed    = 1234,
  refresh = 200
)
```

```{r}
summary(fit_cgslopes)
mcmc_plot(fit_cgslopes, type = "trace")
pp_check(fit_cgslopes, type = "bars_grouped", group = "CGsite")
pp_check(fit_cgslopes, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
pp_check(fit_cgslopes, type = "bars_grouped", group = "timedayz")
```

```{r}
#Plot of conditional effects for CpG site DNA methylation across infection:
ce <- conditional_effects(fit_cgslopes, effects = "timedayz:CGsite")
ce_df <- ce[["timedayz:CGsite"]]

real_days     <- c(0, 0.25, 1, 6, 9, 12, 14)
real_timedayz <- (real_days - timeday_mean) / timeday_sd 

points_grid <- expand.grid(
  timedayz = real_timedayz,
  CGsite   = levels(df_blood$CGsite)
)

point_preds <- fitted(fit_cgslopes, newdata = points_grid, re_formula = NA)
points_df <- cbind(points_grid, estimate__ = point_preds[, "Estimate"])

theme_pub_bw <- theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.line         = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text         = element_text(color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.title        = element_text(color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title       = element_blank(),
    legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key         = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )

cpg_colors <- c("black", "#E69F00", "#0072B2", "#009E73", "#CC79A7")
cpg_shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 3, 4)
cpg_labels <- c("CpG 1", "CpG 2", "CpG 3", "CpG 4", "CpG 5")

p_color <- ggplot(ce_df, aes(x = timedayz, y = estimate__, group = CGsite)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__, fill = CGsite), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(color = CGsite), linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = points_df, aes(x = timedayz, y = estimate__, shape = CGsite),
           color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = cpg_shapes, labels = cpg_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cpg_colors, labels = cpg_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cpg_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Infection time (standardized)",
       y = expression("DNA methylation probability" ~ ~ (hat(p))),
       shape = NULL, color = NULL, title = NULL) +
  theme_pub_bw

p_color
```

#Slope extractions:
```{r}
# Extract random effects slopes from DNAm model
re_Bird   <- ranef(fit_cgslopes)$BirdID
re_Site   <- ranef(fit_cgslopes)$`BirdID:CGsite` # intercepts only, slopes are from fixed effects

# Extract fixed effects
fe <- fixef(fit_cgslopes)
#Compute per-site slope
# fixed-effect slope for timedayz
beta_time <- fe["timedayz","Estimate"]

# site-specific fixed-effect slope deviations
site_slopes_fixed <- c(
  "CG-01" = 0,
  "CG-02" = fe["timedayz:CGsiteCGM02","Estimate"],
  "CG-03" = fe["timedayz:CGsiteCGM03","Estimate"],
  "CG-04" = fe["timedayz:CGsiteCGM04","Estimate"],
  "CG-05" = fe["timedayz:CGsiteCGM05","Estimate"]
)

# random slope for each Bird
bird_slopes <- re_Bird[,,"timedayz"][,"Estimate"]
names(bird_slopes) <- rownames(re_Bird)

# Build Bird × Site dataset
df_slopes <- expand_grid(
  BirdID = names(bird_slopes),
  CGsite = names(site_slopes_fixed)
) %>%
  mutate(
    slope = beta_time +
            site_slopes_fixed[CGsite] +
            bird_slopes[BirdID]
  )

#df_slopes should contain 1 slope per bird per site

#Merging slopes into bird level traits
df_slope_predictors <- df_slopes %>%
  left_join(df_blood %>% 
              select(BirdID, FinalSBc, EP, Stage, BodyMassz) %>% distinct(),
            by = "BirdID")

```


#Model 2 LOO comparisons:
```{r}
#Candidate model definition, fitting for comparison, and LOO-IC extraction:
#All use Gaussian distribution

#FinalSBc = standardized log10 equivalents for Salmonella burden, mean = 0, SD = 1

#Model i:
form_burden_ep_only <- bf(
  FinalSBc ~ slope * EP + (1|CGsite),
  family = gaussian()
)

#Model ii:
form_burden_full <- bf(
  FinalSBc ~ slope * EP + Stage + BodyMassz + (1|CGsite),
  family = gaussian()
)

#Model iii:
form_burden_no_stage <- bf(
  FinalSBc ~ slope * EP + BodyMassz + (1|CGsite),
  family = gaussian()
)

#Model iv:
form_burden_no_bodymass <- bf(
  FinalSBc ~ slope * EP + Stage + (1|CGsite),
  family = gaussian()
)

```

```{r}
#Specifying weakly informative priors for all candidate models:
prior_finalSB_site <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b"),               
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 1)", class = "Intercept"),  
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 1)", class = "sigma"),       
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 1)", class = "sd", group = "CGsite") 
)
```

```{r}
#Subsetting data for LOO comparisons only
#Selected model will be fit with full dataset
df_slope_predictors_cc <- df_slope_predictors %>%
  filter(complete.cases(FinalSBc, slope, EP, Stage, BodyMassz, CGsite))
```

```{r}
#Candidate model fitting:

#Model i:
fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_burden_ep_only,
  data   = df_slope_predictors_cc,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = prior_finalSB_site,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 6000,
  warmup = 3000,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 777
)

#Model ii:
fit_burden_full_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_burden_full,
  data   = df_slope_predictors_cc,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = prior_finalSB_site,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 6000,
  warmup = 3000,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 777
)

#Model iii:
fit_burden_no_stage_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_burden_no_stage,
  data   = df_slope_predictors_cc,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = prior_finalSB_site,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 6000,
  warmup = 3000,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 777
)

#Model iv:
fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo <- brm(
  formula = form_burden_no_bodymass,
  data   = df_slope_predictors_cc,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = prior_finalSB_site,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 6000,
  warmup = 3000,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(2),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 777
)
```

```{r}
#LOO comparison:
fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo <- add_criterion(fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo, "loo")
fit_burden_full_loo <- add_criterion(fit_burden_full_loo, "loo")
fit_burden_no_stage_loo <- add_criterion(fit_burden_no_stage_loo, "loo")
fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo <- add_criterion(fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo, "loo")

loo_compare(fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo, fit_burden_full, fit_burden_no_stage_loo, fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo)

print(fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo$criteria$loo)
print(fit_burden_full_loo$criteria$loo)
print(fit_burden_no_stage_loo$criteria$loo)
print(fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo$criteria$loo)

#Model comparison chart
loo_list_SB <- list(
  fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo = fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo$criteria$loo,
  fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo = fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo$criteria$loo,
  fit_burden_no_stage_loo    = fit_burden_no_stage_loo$criteria$loo,
  fit_burden_full_loo       = fit_burden_full_loo$criteria$loo
)

loo_summary_SB <- purrr::map_dfr(loo_list_SB, function(x) {
  e <- x$estimates
  tibble::tibble(
    elpd_loo    = e["elpd_loo","Estimate"], se_elpd_loo = e["elpd_loo","SE"],
    p_loo       = e["p_loo","Estimate"],    se_p_loo    = e["p_loo","SE"],
    looic       = e["looic","Estimate"],    se_looic    = e["looic","SE"]
  )
}, .id = "Model")

comp_SB <- loo_compare(fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo, fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo,
                     fit_burden_no_stage_loo, fit_burden_full_loo)
comp_df_SB <- as.data.frame(comp_SB) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Model") %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, elpd_diff, se_diff)

loo_table_SB <- dplyr::left_join(loo_summary_SB, comp_df, by = "Model")

loo_table_SB <- loo_table_SB %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Model = dplyr::recode(Model,
    fit_FinalSB_slope_orig_loo = "Minimal (slope*EP)",
    fit_burden_no_bodymass_loo = "No BodyMassz",
    fit_burden_no_stage_loo    = "No Stage",
    fit_burden_full_loo         = "Full (+ Stage + BodyMassz)"
  ))

loo_table_SB
```
